# Hiring.cafe Job Listings & Salary Filter Scraper

Hiring.cafe aggregates job postings pulled directly from Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, Workday, SuccessFactors, BambooHR, and thousands of other applicant-tracking systems and company career pages. This actor queries that aggregated index and returns structured job records, so you can filter on dimensions — salary band, security clearance, required tech stack — that most job boards don't expose in their own search UI.

## What this actor does

- Runs one or more keyword searches against hiring.cafe's job index and collects matching postings.
- Narrows results by workplace type, seniority, commitment type, years of experience, security clearance, and salary range/currency/frequency.
- Matches separately against job title text, job description text, parsed technology tags, and parsed requirement bullets, so you can target precise phrasing rather than a single blended search box.
- Includes company-level filters (whitelist/blacklist by name or keyword, industry include/exclude) so you can scope a run to or away from specific employers.
- Returns one record per job with company, compensation, and location detail; fields the source doesn't provide for a given job are left out of that record.

## Output per job

- `id` – unique hiring.cafe job ID.
- `objectID` – search-index object ID for the posting.
- `source` – originating ATS (e.g. greenhouse, lever, workable, successfactors).
- `boardToken` – job board token used by the source ATS.
- `applyUrl` – link back to the original listing on the source ATS.
- `title` – job title as posted.
- `description` – job description text (HTML tags stripped).
- `coreJobTitle` – hiring.cafe's canonicalized version of the title.
- `category` – job category, e.g. Engineering, Data, Marketing.
- `seniorityLevel` – seniority classification, e.g. Entry Level, Senior Level, Director.
- `roleType` – Individual Contributor or People Manager.
- `commitment` – Full Time, Part Time, Contract, Internship, Temporary, Seasonal, or Volunteer.
- `workplaceType` – Remote, Hybrid, or Onsite.
- `workplaceCountries` – country codes where the role is based.
- `workplaceStates` – state or region names where the role is based.
- `workplaceCities` – city names where the role is based.
- `latitude` / `longitude` – primary geolocation of the listed workplace, when hiring.cafe provides one (both come back as `0.0` when it doesn't).
- `salaryMin` / `salaryMax` – disclosed compensation range.
- `salaryCurrency` – currency code for the disclosed range.
- `salaryFrequency` – pay period for the disclosed range (Yearly, Monthly, Weekly, Daily, Hourly).
- `technicalTools` – technologies/tools mentioned in the posting.
- `minYearsExperience` – minimum years of experience parsed from the posting.
- `bachelorsDegreeRequirement` – degree requirement level, when stated.
- `companyName` – hiring company name.
- `companyWebsite` – company homepage URL.
- `companyIndustries` – industry tags for the hiring company.
- `companyEmployees` – employee-count bucket for the hiring company.
- `companyHqCountry` – country code of the company's headquarters.
- `isExpired` – whether hiring.cafe has marked the listing expired.
- `scrapedAt` – ISO 8601 timestamp of when this actor fetched the record.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `searchQueries` | Array of strings | – | Keywords searched against hiring.cafe (e.g. `"software engineer"`). Leave empty for unfiltered results. |
| `workplaceTypes` | Array (select) | `["Remote","Hybrid","Onsite"]` | Restrict to these workplace types. |
| `locations` | Array | – | Location filter: plain strings (`"San Francisco"`, `"United States"`) or objects with `label`, `value`, `countryCode`, `stateCode`, `city`, `lat`, `lng`. Empty = global. |
| `jobTitleQuery` | String | – | Only jobs whose title contains this phrase. |
| `jobDescriptionQuery` | String | – | Only jobs whose description contains this phrase. |
| `technologyKeywordsQuery` | String | – | Match against parsed technology tags (e.g. `python`, `kubernetes`). |
| `requirementsKeywordsQuery` | String | – | Match against parsed requirement bullets. |
| `companyNames` | Array of strings | – | Only return jobs from these companies. |
| `excludedCompanyNames` | Array of strings | – | Exclude jobs from these companies. |
| `companyKeywords` | Array of strings | – | Substring match against company name (include). |
| `excludedCompanyKeywords` | Array of strings | – | Substring match against company name (exclude). |
| `industries` | Array of strings | – | Only companies in these industries. |
| `excludedIndustries` | Array of strings | – | Exclude companies in these industries. |
| `salaryCurrency` | String (select) | `""` (any) | Currency used to evaluate `minSalary`/`maxSalary`. |
| `salaryFrequency` | String (select) | `""` (any) | Pay period used to evaluate `minSalary`/`maxSalary`. |
| `minSalary` | Integer | – | Lower compensation bound, combined with currency + frequency. |
| `maxSalary` | Integer | – | Upper compensation bound. |
| `onlyTransparentSalaries` | Boolean | `false` | Drop jobs that don't publish a salary range. |
| `minYearsExperience` | Integer | `0` | Only jobs requiring at least this many years of experience. |
| `maxYearsExperience` | Integer | `20` | Only jobs requiring at most this many years of experience. |
| `securityClearances` | Array (select) | – | Only jobs requiring one of these clearance levels (e.g. `Secret`, `Top Secret`). |
| `sortBy` | String (select) | `"default"` | Result order: `default` (relevance), `newest`, `oldest`, `salary_high_to_low`, `salary_low_to_high`. |
| `seniorityLevels` | Array (select) | `["No Prior Experience Required", "Entry Level", "Mid Level", "Senior Level", "Director", "Executive"]` | Restrict to these seniority levels. |
| `commitmentTypes` | Array (select) | `["Full Time", "Part Time", "Contract", "Internship", "Temporary", "Seasonal", "Volunteer"]` | Restrict to these commitment types. |
| `dateFetchedPastNDays` | Integer | `30` | Only include jobs fetched within the last N days. |
| `maxItems` | Integer | `50` | Maximum number of jobs to return across all queries. |

### Example: remote senior engineering roles with disclosed pay

```json
{
    "searchQueries": ["software engineer"],
    "workplaceTypes": ["Remote"],
    "seniorityLevels": ["Senior Level", "Director"],
    "onlyTransparentSalaries": true,
    "salaryCurrency": "USD",
    "salaryFrequency": "Yearly",
    "minSalary": 150000,
    "maxItems": 100
}
```

### Example: cleared roles near a specific company

```json
{
    "searchQueries": [],
    "excludedCompanyNames": ["Acme Corp"],
    "securityClearances": ["Secret", "Top Secret"],
    "dateFetchedPastNDays": 14,
    "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: contract/part-time roles mentioning a specific tech stack

```json
{
    "searchQueries": ["data engineer"],
    "commitmentTypes": ["Contract", "Part Time"],
    "technologyKeywordsQuery": "airflow",
    "maxItems": 30
}
```

## Use cases

- **Talent intelligence** – track hiring velocity for a role, company, or region over time.
- **Compensation benchmarking** – aggregate disclosed salary ranges by role, seniority, and location.
- **Remote-work research** – isolate `workplaceTypes: ["Remote"]` postings to study the remote-first job market.
- **ATS/tooling market share** – group results by `source` to see which applicant-tracking systems dominate hiring.
- **Skills-demand tracking** – aggregate `technicalTools` across postings to spot which technologies are rising in demand.
- **Targeted job alerts** – run narrow filters (keyword + location + seniority) on a schedule to catch new matching postings.

## FAQ

**Does this cover jobs outside the US?**
Yes. hiring.cafe aggregates listings globally; use `locations`, `workplaceCountries` in the output, or leave `locations` empty for worldwide results.

**Why do some jobs have `salaryMin`/`salaryMax` of `0`?**
Many postings don't disclose compensation. When a listing has no published salary, both fields come back as `0`. Set `onlyTransparentSalaries` to `true` to keep only listings that publish a range.

**What's the difference between `seniorityLevel` and `minYearsExperience`?**
`seniorityLevel` is hiring.cafe's categorical tag (e.g. `Mid Level`, `Senior Level`). `minYearsExperience` is the numeric minimum years parsed from the job description text, and may be `0` when the posting doesn't state a number.

**How do `searchQueries` and the other text filters interact?**
`searchQueries` is the general keyword search hiring.cafe runs against the whole posting. `jobTitleQuery`, `jobDescriptionQuery`, `technologyKeywordsQuery`, and `requirementsKeywordsQuery` are additional, more targeted filters applied on top of that search.

**Can I pull postings from one employer only?**
Yes, set `companyNames` to that employer's name (or use `companyKeywords` for a partial match). Use `excludedCompanyNames`/`excludedCompanyKeywords` to do the opposite.

**Does `dateFetchedPastNDays` reflect the original posting date?**
No — it reflects when hiring.cafe's own index last fetched the listing, which is the freshness signal the source provides.

**Are expired listings included?**
hiring.cafe's active search only surfaces current postings, so `isExpired` is normally `false`; the field is kept in the output for completeness.

**Is this affiliated with hiring.cafe?**
No. This actor is an independent tool that queries hiring.cafe's public job search and is not affiliated with or endorsed by hiring.cafe.
